list.title: Chat triggers
list.error: The chat triggers could not load.
list.pick: Pick a trigger to edit it.

editor.enabledHelp: A trigger that is off stays in the list and answers nothing.
editor.caseSensitiveHelp: Off means Hello and hello are the same.
editor.cooldownHelp: The whole channel waits this long before the trigger answers again.
editor.confirmBody: The trigger is removed for good. It stops answering.

dialog.title: New chat trigger
dialog.description: Pick the words to watch for and what the bot says back.
dialog.patternRequired: Give the trigger some words to watch for.

list.title: Timers
list.pick: Pick a timer to edit it.

editor.enabledHelp: A timer that is off stays in the list and posts nothing.
editor.name: Name
editor.messagesHelp: One message per line. The timer posts them in turn.
editor.intervalHelp: Default {minutes}. The timer waits this long between posts.
editor.intervalProblem: Use a whole number from {minMinutes} to {maxMinutes} minutes.
editor.activityProblem: Use a whole number from 0 to {maxActivity} chat lines.
editor.activityHelp: Default {lines}. The timer waits until chat has this many new lines since its last post.
editor.onceHelp: The timer posts one time and then turns itself off.
editor.speakHelp: Each post also plays as speech on your stream.
editor.confirmBody: The timer is removed for good. It stops posting.

dialog.title: New timer
dialog.description: Pick a name, what the timer says and how often it posts.
